headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 5, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Braxton Ashcraft leading the way on the mound. Ashcraft pitched 5.2 innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run. The Minnesota Twins also secured a convincing 11-4 victory over the New York Yankees, with Josh Bell leading the charge at the plate. Bell hit 3 home runs, including a key 13th homer on a fly ball to right center field, scoring Kody Clemens. The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Texas Rangers, winning 3-0.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their teams' lineups. Brandon Woodruff, a right-hander for the Milwaukee Brewers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. Tomoyuki Sugano, Seth Halvorsen, and Matt Gage have also been placed on the injured list by their respective teams. Ha-Seong Kim, a shortstop for the Atlanta Braves, has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 1, 2026, due to right middle finger inflammation.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place around the league. The Cleveland Guardians acquired Ryan Degges from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for cash. The Washington Nationals acquired Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros in exchange for cash and Kyle Nicolas from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for Ben Hansen.

top_news.title: **Tigers Shut Out Rangers 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Texas Rangers, winning 3-0. Jack Flaherty led the way for the Tigers, pitching 5.2 innings with 5 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Suffer Shutout Loss in Seattle**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays were defeated by the Seattle Mariners 11-0, marking a tough outing for the visiting team. Randy Arozarena led the Blue Jays' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 3-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, handing the visitors their loss. Taylor Ward and Blaze Alexander led the Orioles' offense, while Spencer Steer and Tyler Stephenson contributed to the Reds' win.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Brandon Woodruff Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-hander Brandon Woodruff has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation.

top_news.title: **Degges Joins Guardians in Trade**
top_news.summary: Ryan Degges has been traded to the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for cash. The move comes as part of a recent trade between the Guardians and the Philadelphia Phillies.
